sources.title: Verify OpenAI-generated content
sources.snippet: The content could still have been generated by OpenAI if its metadata was stripped or tampered with, its watermark was degraded, it came from a legacy generation model, or it was created before provenance signals were available. Content could also still be AI-generated by another company's model, which the tool currently does not detect.

sources.title: AI Detector: Free AI Checker for ChatGPT, Claude & GPT-5 - QuillBot
sources.snippet: An AI detector (also called an AI checker or AI content detector) analyzes text to evaluate how likely it was generated by AI. It searches for patterns common to AI-generated text and determines how likely it is the writer used a platform like GPT-4, GPT-5, ChatGPT or Claude. AI content detection is used by educators, editors, SEO professionals, and businesses to make sure content is original.
